description: Protocols ranked by fees or revenue for the latest completed day, with the 24h change, the chains they earn on and their version splits, 50 per page. The 7d fields are real sums of the last seven days including the latest one. The 24h changes are null when the day before had no value. Free data from AlphaGrowth (alphagrowth.io).

sort_order.description: desc for the highest first, asc for the lowest.
